notes.title: Update - Mission Files
notes.content:
Mission Files adds a recap in the beggining of the Leviathan campaign, allowing for new and old players to learne about the events of prior games.

[list]
[*] This update also includes controller compatibility. 
[/list] 


Stay tuned for [b]Grand Finale[/b], the final free expansion update for Calmed by the Dark Leviathan!

notes.title: Calmed by the Dark Leviathan - In:Finity

tags.feature: Explore dungeons, collect monsters and uncover what happened to mankind in [b]In:Finity[/b], a new game mode for [b]Calmed by the Dark Leviathan[/b].
A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
- Upgrade your character for higher survival chances;
